name: Wrath++ native
description: What Wrath++'s interface can't do in the stock 32-bit client: the creator's current choice and option count per customization (WrathPP_GetCustomization, WrathPP_SetCustomization), whose character is made (WrathPP_GetCreating), its starting outfit (WrathPP_SetGear), the creator's log lines (WrathPP_Log), the screen for the app's touch (WrathPP_SetScreen), the body options' layer on a character with bare legs (a detour in GeosRenderPrep), and the parts a character of the world wears (WrathPP_ApplyLook).
